children.blockName: Minimalism is not just about having less; it is about making room for more of what matters. In this essay, we explore the principles of reduction and clarity, and how they shape our digital and physical environments. When we strip away the non-essential, we are left with the core of the message. In UI design, this means removing decorative elements that do not serve a functional purpose. It forces the designer to prioritize content and hierarchy. "Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away."
Lead Designer at Frappe Tech. Passionate about minimalism, typography, and sustainable design systems.

page_data_script:
slug = frappe.form_dict.slug

post_exists = frappe.db.exists("Cafe Post", {"slug": slug})

if not post_exists:
    raise frappe.PageDoesNotExistError

post = frappe.get_doc("Cafe Post", {"slug": slug})

dt = frappe.utils.getdate(post.creation)
months = [
    "Jan",
    "Feb",
    "Mar",
    "Apr",
    "May",
    "Jun",
    "Jul",
    "Aug",
    "Sep",
    "Oct",
    "Nov",
    "Dec",
]
post.creation = f"{months[dt.month - 1]} {dt.day} {dt.year}"

comment_count = (
    frappe.db.count("Cafe Post Comment", filters={"post": post.name}) or "No"
)


def format_number(num):
    if num is None:
        return ""

    num = float(num)
    abs_num = abs(num)

    if abs_num >= 1_000_000_000:
        return f"{num / 1_000_000_000:.1f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".") + "b"
    elif abs_num >= 1_000_000:
        return f"{num / 1_000_000:.1f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".") + "m"
    elif abs_num >= 1_000:
        return f"{num / 1_000:.1f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".") + "k"
    else:
        return str(int(num)) if num == int(num) else str(num)


like_count = format_number(
    frappe.db.count("Cafe Social Like", filters={"post": post.name})
)

Comment = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe Post Comment")
User = frappe.qb.DocType("User")
CafeUser = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe User")

comments_limit = int(frappe.form_dict.commentsCursor or 0) + 10

query = (
    frappe.qb.from_(Comment)
    .inner_join(User)
    .on(Comment.owner == User.name)
    .left_join(CafeUser)
    .on(Comment.owner == CafeUser.name)
    .select(
        Comment.name,
        Comment.content,
        Comment.owner,
        Comment.creation,
        User.full_name,
        User.user_image,
        CafeUser.handle,
    )
    .where(Comment.post == post.name)
    .orderby(Comment.creation, order=frappe.qb.desc)
    .limit(comments_limit)
)
comments = query.run(as_dict=True)
if comments:
    comment_names = [c.name for c in comments]
    Like = frappe.qb.DocType("Cafe Social Like")
    likes_query = (
        frappe.qb.from_(Like)
        .select(Like.comment, frappe.qb.functions("Count", Like.name).as_("count"))
        .where(Like.comment.isin(comment_names))
        .groupby(Like.comment)
    )
    likes_result = likes_query.run(as_dict=True)
    likes_map = {row.comment: row.count for row in likes_result}

    for comment in comments:
        comment.likes = likes_map.get(comment.name, 0)
        comment.time_ago = frappe.utils.pretty_date(comment.creation)
        comment.author_url = f"/cafe/profile/{comment.handle}"
        comment.liked_by_me = (
            1
            if bool(
                frappe.db.exists(
                    "Cafe Social Like",
                    {"comment": comment.name, "owner": frappe.session.user},
                )
            )
            else 0
        )

data.post = {
    "name": post.name,
    "title": post.title,
    "content": post.content,
    "cover_image": post.cover_image,
    "reading_time": post.reading_time,
    "creation": post.creation,
    "tags": post.tags,
    "comment_count": comment_count,
    "like_count": like_count,
    "comments": comments,
    "liked_by_me": 1
    if bool(
        frappe.db.exists(
            "Cafe Social Like", {"owner": frappe.session.user, "post": post.name}
        )
    )
    else 0,
    "bookmarked_by_me": 1
    if bool(
        frappe.db.exists(
            "Cafe Post Bookmark", {"post": post.name, "owner": frappe.session.user}
        )
    )
    else 0,
    "show_load_more_btn": comment_count > 10,
}

if post.publisher:
    author = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Cafe Publication",
        post.publisher,
        ["name", "title", "handle", "description", "image"],
        as_dict=1,
    )
else:
    user = frappe.db.get_value(
        "User", post.owner, ["user_image", "full_name"], as_dict=1
    )
    author = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Cafe User",
        post.owner,
        ["name", "handle", "company", "designation", "bio"],
        as_dict=1,
    )


filter = {"publisher": author.name} if post.publisher else {"user": author.name}

data.author = {
    "name": user.full_name if not post.publisher else author.title,
    "handle": author.handle if not post.publisher else author.handle,
    "image": user.user_image if not post.publisher else author.image,
    "bio": author.bio if not post.publisher else author.description,
    "is_subscribed": bool(
        frappe.db.exists("Cafe Subscription", {"owner": frappe.session.user, **filter})
    ),
    "author_url": f"/cafe/profile/{author.handle}",
    "is_publisher": 1 if bool(post.publisher) else 0,
}

data.page_data = {
    "author": data.author,
    "post": {
        "name": post.name,
        "title": post.title,
        "description": post.description,
        "bookmarked_by_me": post.bookmarked_by_me,
    },
}
